title: Claude Quant
author: NathanReeves0
selftext:
**I built a QUANT trading bot with Claude Fable 5.**

Over the last 54 days it generated **$81,323** by trading across multiple prediction and crypto markets.

• 25,511 trades/predictions  
• 46% win rate  
• \~$1,500/day average

The strategy isn't about predicting the market.

It continuously scans for temporary price dislocations, identifies positive EV opportunities, and executes trades automatically before the edge disappears.

https://preview.redd.it/m22s6qy98chh1.png?width=680&format=png&auto=webp&s=421cf60c2dfcc346855f16bc33d64cd9df8b23d1

Claude acts as the reasoning engine while the infrastructure monitors markets 24/7, manages risk, rotates inventory, and executes orders autonomously.

No emotions. No discretionary trading. Just thousands of small statistical edges repeated over and over.

I'm putting together the complete architecture, prompts, and workflow if people are interested.
